attempts.summary: Built the double-NAT path (node3/lan-a -> node1 -> transit -> node2 -> node4/lan-b:8080) so node4 records the connection as arriving from node2's lan-b address. Then executed the mandatory one-node-at-a-time restart protocol on all four nodes, confirming boot-identity change and full recovery (config, services, and end-to-end connectivity) after each restart.
